data.one_liner: Shows brief overlay messages (toasts) on Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to display short, transient messages at the top, center, or bottom of the screen. Supports basic styling such as text style, background color, radius, and optional border. Includes web support.
use_when: You need lightweight, quick user feedback without a full dialog
You want a cross‑platform toast that works on web as well as mobile
avoid_when: You require complex animations or rich media in notifications
You need advanced notification features like scheduling or push integration
strengths: Very easy to use with a single static call
Customizable appearance (text style, background, radius, border)
Web support added in recent versions
weaknesses: No built‑in support for action buttons or callbacks
data.setup_notes: Call ToastContext.init(context) once (e.g., in your root widget) before showing toasts

alternatives.name: fluttertoast
alternatives.why_pick_it: More mature, supports Android/iOS natively and offers additional positioning options

alternatives.name: toastification
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides richer styling and animation options
